summary: Tested Totem Produzione feature. Backend: 10/12 tests pass. Frontend: full totem flow works (login form → board → detail → operator modal → row toggle → persistence → finalize DDT with success badge). Redirects for produzione role work correctly (/, /dashboard, /clienti, /login → /produzione). JWT expiry differentiation works (~90d totem vs ~12h admin). RBAC gap detected: produzione role can GET /api/fatture and /api/costi (should be 403).

critical.issue: Produzione role receives 200 (list of invoices) instead of 403. Endpoint uses only get_current_user with no role/permission check. Same for GET /api/fatture/{id}, /api/fatture/{id}/pdf, /api/fatture/{id}/xml.
Produzione role receives 200 instead of 403. list_costi and get_costo use only get_current_user. Only write endpoints require roles.

action_items: Fix RBAC on /api/fatture list & detail endpoints: replace get_current_user with require_roles('admin','contabilita') OR require_permission('fatture','view') so 'produzione' users are rejected with 403.
Fix RBAC on /api/costi list & detail endpoints: same treatment (require_permission('costi','view') or require_roles).

Recommended: audit all other GET endpoints (fornitori, hr, dipendenti, report...) — the 'produzione' role default permissions matrix disables them but many read endpoints only use get_current_user, so they bypass the matrix.
critical_code_review_comments: core.py has a role-scoped permission matrix (_ROLE_DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS) with 'produzione' having only ordinativi (view+edit) + ddt (view). However most read endpoints (fatture, costi, fornitori list, etc.) don't call has_permission/require_permission — they only call get_current_user, bypassing the matrix entirely. The RBAC design is inconsistent: matrix exists but not enforced for reads.
converti-ddt endpoint allows 'produzione' role, which is correct for totem, but the /api/ddt/{id}/pdf endpoint uses get_current_user (correctly, so produzione can print) — this is fine.
PATCH /ordinativi/{oid}/produzione correctly validates righe_eseguite length (422) and rejects convertito_ddt/annullato states (409).
Produzione.jsx: printDdt uses hidden iframe; iframe is never removed from DOM (memory leak on multiple prints). Also URL.createObjectURL is never revoked.
seed_data_creation: Test creates ordinativi on demand via admin POST /api/ordinativi when no 'nuovo' orders exist. Uses TEST_ prefix implicitly via numero counter.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for totem is /app/backend/tests/test_iter38_totem_produzione.py. Two tests fail: test_produzione_cannot_access_fatture and test_produzione_cannot_access_costi — these are legitimate RBAC bugs, not test issues. All other totem features (JWT 90d, ordinativi access, PATCH produzione, converti-ddt, PDF download, redirects, board UI, operator modal, row persistence, success badge) verified working. Frontend UI uses window.print via hidden iframe which won't fire in headless — verify only success badge appearance.
